status: proposed implementation contract; no runtime implementation or performance acceptance claimed

supported_source.v1_behavior: Artifact download remains available; the six views reject version 1.
supported_source.unknown_field_policy: Reject an unsupported shape rather than silently discard source fields.
supported_source.strict_json: Reject duplicate keys, nonfinite numbers, invalid UTF-8, trailing data and depth violations.

wire_numbers.scientific_numbers: Every integer or finite number from scientific records, summary, provenance clinical data and source metadata is returned as an exact canonical decimal string. Preserve null.
wire_numbers.numeric_filters: Canonical decimal strings with exact decimal comparisons; integer source fields require integral strings.
wire_numbers.canonicalization: No exponent, leading plus, leading zeros, negative zero or redundant fractional zeros. Expand source exponent notation losslessly. Do not pass through binary float.
wire_numbers.source_string_policy: A source string is never coerced to a number or boolean. Opaque strings containing JSON are not parsed.
wire_numbers.bounded_view_counts: Only adapter-generated counts bounded by acceptance limits, such as returned_count and matched_count, are JSON integers. Source counts and summary counts are strings.
wire_numbers.number_limits: Canonical numeric strings longer than 1024 characters produce export_budget_exceeded, never rounded numbers.

provenance.accepted_clinical_profile: bounded object; recursively encode scientific numeric scalars as decimal strings

provenance_absent: complete VEP and reference release manifest
source_root.extra_data_policy: The adapter does not reconstruct absent source provenance.

genome_build.note: Whitelisted export field, absent from inspected base DDL; do not infer an assembly when unavailable.

acmg_class.note: Column is required by the source exporter; the source DDL permits a null class. Do not infer a classification.

allelic_depth.note: Opaque source string; no derived VAF in this phase.

acmg_rule_evidence.note: Opaque source VARCHAR, not an established nested rule-trace schema.

variant_idx.link: Exact foreign key to variants.variant_idx within the same artifact only.
Exact foreign key to variants.variant_idx within the same artifact only.

gene_mentions.note: Exact source-reported string membership, not a proven gene or causal association.

variant_matches.note: Source strings, not canonical allele IDs or variant_idx foreign keys.

keys.similarity_score: finite number to canonical decimal string

phenotype_matches.individual_matches.query: whole-value projection only; no JSONPath filtering

nested_fields.literature_string_arrays: gene_mentions, variant_matches and phenotype_matches are arrays of strings, not canonical relational identifiers.

variants.state: absent; do not fabricate a source module state

phenotype_matches.empty_success_exception: succeeded with reason=no_variants_with_hpo and zero rows is valid

screening_results.analyzed_count: Original source count is a decimal string and may differ from retained row_count.

rules: A failed, skipped or not_requested collection cannot be reported as a successful empty query.
For succeeded collections the validated array length must equal row_count.
Arrays for failed, skipped and not_requested modules must be empty.
A filter or sort on a source-unavailable field returns field_unavailable, including is_null.
Projecting a source-unavailable field retains null plus unavailable_fields. Present null and source-unavailable remain distinct.
No raw input coverage, mutable UI overrides or current annotation is inferred.

gene_summary_stream.query_records: Only type=gene records are query rows. Preserve the type/data wrapper and source ordinal. Metadata and completion are separate collection context.
metadata_required_checks: total_genes and total_variants are nonnegative integers
impact_by_acmg is an object of class-keyed impact count objects
gene_summary_stream.gene_data_optional: Other registered fields may be absent or null; do not synthesize zeros.
invariants: Metadata first, completion last, no records after completion.
Gene symbols are exact source strings and unique.
total_streamed equals actual gene-record count and metadata.total_genes.
Metadata and completion session_id match the artifact case_id.
No invariant equating metadata.total_variants with variants.row_count is asserted.

query_rules.predicate_combination: AND only; IN represents alternatives for the same field.
query_rules.string_semantics: Literal, case-sensitive Unicode codepoint comparison; no regex, locale collation or fuzzy aliases.
query_rules.null_semantics: Non-null comparisons on present null do not match, including ne. is_null and is_not_null are explicit. No missing-value coercion.
query_rules.sort: Requested fields in order with nulls last for both directions, then primary key ascending as final tie-breaker. Default primary key ascending. Do not duplicate a sort field.
query_rules.clinical_order: String class/tier sorts are literal lexical order, not a new clinical severity ranking.
query_rules.projection: Always include primary identity and its source wrapper; source ordinal is adapter metadata. Default projection uses the explicit compact per-collection list below. Requested source-unavailable fields retain unavailable metadata.
query_rules.gene_lookup: Exact source gene_symbol only. One requested collection per call. No alias expansion or causal inference.

gene_links.phenotype_matches: Select rows whose own source gene_symbol exactly equals the requested string. Validate variant_idx against the same artifact variants without borrowing or rewriting a conflicting variant gene label.
gene_links.screening_results: Select only through exact same-artifact variants.variant_idx whose source gene_symbol equals requested source string
gene_links.literature_results: Excluded from gene helper; source mention queries remain available through the general record query.

source_integrity: Validate unique non-null primary keys and non-null allele identity fields; required source columns do not by themselves establish non-null clinical values.
Validate phenotype and screening foreign keys against the same artifact variants collection.
Require source scalars to match declared types; no boolean-as-integer coercion.
query_rules.sparse_gene_fields: Gene-summary optional fields can be absent in individual records. Do not fill missing values. A requested predicate/sort depending on a missing source value reports field_unavailable rather than treating it as present null. Schema field availability reports this limitation.

tool_outputs.get_analysis_export_summary: Source summary and collection coverage; no newly calculated clinical totals. Source counts are decimal strings.
tool_outputs.get_analysis_export_schema: Registry fields, actual unavailable fields, allowed predicates and sorts, nested schemas and exact projection limitations.
tool_outputs.query_analysis_export_records: One collection; records, bounded integer returned_count and matched_count, has_more and authenticated next_cursor when present.
tool_outputs.get_analysis_export_variant: One exact variant_idx with recorded evidence. Full record or typed response_budget_exceeded; never silently truncate evidence. No invented rule trace.
tool_outputs.get_analysis_export_gene_records: One collection for one exact source gene, with the same bounded pagination and source-link semantics.
tool_outputs.get_analysis_export_provenance: Exact manifest/artifact identity, source provenance and coverage. Return typed response_budget_exceeded if accepted clinical profile does not fit; the authorized artifact remains downloadable.

manifest_validation.canonical_hash: Remove only manifest_sha256; serialize recursively sorted keys as compact UTF-8 JSON using comma/colon separators and ASCII escaping, then SHA256.
manifest_validation.artifact_hash: Verify exact downloaded bytes, byte length and descriptor SHA256; never hash reparsed or pretty-printed JSON.
identity_checks: Manifest and artifact analysis_id, case_id, generation_id and schema_version agree.
Optional expected_generation_id is a conflict check, never a selector for a different current result.
Use the current authorized manifest to select exactly one JSON artifact of the supported shape.
Do not follow arbitrary descriptor hosts or paths.
Manifest expiry and current API admission are rechecked before every disclosure.
Never substitute the private sealed-generation manifest digest for public export manifest_sha256.

cache_and_cursor.credential_fingerprint: Server-private keyed fingerprint of the actual credential; never the credential itself and never model-visible.
cache_and_cursor.authority: No principal or context IDs are fabricated from claims absent in the current API response. Credential fingerprint and successful current API admission bind disclosure.
cache_and_cursor.cursor: Opaque authenticated token, bound to the actual manifest and exact normalized query. No embedded clinical values in model-visible cursors; server-side state or encryption protects sort tuples.
cache_and_cursor.access: Fresh successful authorized manifest read before each cache/resource/page disclosure. Revocation, expiry or API admission failure prevents cached fallback.
cache_and_cursor.rotation: A different credential fingerprint gets a different cache namespace even if it later proves access to the same export.

limits.performance_status: Proposed acceptance limits; no measured WGS capability or performance claim.

errors.unsupported_export_schema: Version is not supported by the six views.
errors.unsupported_export_shape: Profile, fields or scalar types differ from the supported closed source contract.
errors.structured_export_unavailable: No JSON artifact exists, including PDF-only output.
errors.field_unavailable: A filter or sort requires a field unavailable in the source.
errors.export_integrity_error: Hash, size, identity, counts, duplicate keys or same-artifact references fail validation.
errors.export_budget_exceeded: Artifact, record, depth, numeric or record-count budget exceeded.
errors.query_budget_exceeded: CPU, parse/index, memory or disk budget exceeded.
errors.response_budget_exceeded: The complete requested response exceeds the byte limit; request fewer fields or rows.
errors.invalid_cursor: Cursor is malformed, unauthorized or query-bound to different arguments.
errors.stale_cursor: Bound source identity, expiry or schema has changed.
errors.generation_conflict: Optional expected_generation_id differs from the authoritative export.

output_semantics.envelope: The output_schemas validate structuredContent only. isError is true for ok=false. Text content is a short safe outcome, not a second copy. The combined serialized MCP result obeys the byte budget.
output_semantics.projection: Unselected scalar fields may be omitted; selected source-unavailable fields are null with unavailable_fields. Identity fields always remain. Numeric scientific source values always use strings, including all nested source counters.
output_semantics.gene_mention_conflicts: The gene helper matches variants and phenotype rows by each collection source gene_symbol. Screening alone links through variant_idx of matched variants. No source gene label is rewritten.
output_semantics.availability: Non-succeeded module states return records=[], returned_count=0, matched_count=null, has_more=false, next_cursor=null. Succeeded empty returns matched_count=0. Variants and validated gene rows use adapter availability=available without inventing a source module state.
output_semantics.pagination: returned_count equals len(records); has_more is true exactly when next_cursor is non-null. matched_count is the full match count within the validated bounded artifact.
output_semantics.schema_output: field_registry is compact descriptor data, not all generated input/output JSON schemas. Its source_available reflects actual source fields, not presence of non-null values.
output_semantics.reference_validation: Input UUID format checks and all output source identities require semantic verification in addition to JSON Schema.
